column4: cleat#2005 GAP2: this test pauses a real sibling Postgres container by container id, which only makes sense against one this job actually controls -- so it is gated behind CLEAT_TEST_DOCKER_PAUSE_CONTAINER and runs in its OWN isolated CI step, after the main "Run tests" step has already finished (see ci.yml's "Locate the Postgres service container" / "Run the docker-pause reproduction (GAP2)" steps). That isolation is exactly why it skips HERE: the main "Run tests" step that produces this job's test-report.json never sets CLEAT_TEST_DOCKER_PAUSE_CONTAINER, so this test's own t.Skip at cmd/cleat-worker/a_real_postgres_docker_pause_idle_worker_gap_test.go:46 fires there every run, by design, while it actually runs (and is asserted on) in the later step. Measured: 1 skip in test-go/commands' main test-report.json, confirmed passing separately in the isolated step on real CI (cleat-review, 2026-09-23: discovered exactly one container, paused 12s, held by the busy worker, passed in 22.18s).
